# vergeio_webhook_url (Resource)

`vergeio_webhook_url` is a destination for VergeOS event notifications. Point it at a chat room, a ticket system, or an automation endpoint. `name` and `url` are required.

`authorization_value_wo` is the credential for `authorization_type`. It is sent when the destination is created and when `authorization_value_wo_version` changes. Terraform stores the version, not the credential. For `basic`, the value is `username:password`. For `bearer`, the token only. For `apikey`, the key only.

`timeout` is seconds from 3 through 120. `retries` is 0 through 100.

Removing this destination also removes its delivery log. [`vergeio_webhook`](webhook.html) is one message sent to this destination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A destination for event notifications.
# authorization_value_wo is sent on create and when the version changes.
# Terraform stores the version, not the credential.

resource "vergeio_webhook_url" "example" {
  name    = "Chat alerts"
  url     = "https://example.com/hooks/chat"
  timeout = 10
  retries = 3

  authorization_type             = "bearer"
  authorization_value_wo         = "example-token"
  authorization_value_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Destination name. Must be unique. 1 to 128 characters.
- `url` (String) HTTP or HTTPS endpoint that receives the POST.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allow_insecure` (Boolean) Allow a TLS certificate VergeOS would otherwise reject. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `authorization_type` (String) How the destination authenticates: none, basic, bearer, or apikey. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `authorization_value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Credential for authorization_type. For basic, use username:password. For bearer, the token only. For apikey, the key only. Sent when the destination is created and when authorization_value_wo_version changes. Terraform does not store it. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11.
- `authorization_value_wo_version` (Number) Version of authorization_value_wo. Increment it to send a new credential. Terraform stores this number, not the credential.
- `headers` (String) HTTP headers, one Name:Value pair per line. Omit to leave the current headers unchanged.
- `retries` (Number) Delivery attempts after the first failure, from 0 through 100. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait for a response, from 3 through 120. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `type` (String) Destination type. VergeOS uses custom. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Webhook destination key assigned by VergeOS.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The `terraform import` command can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vergeio_webhook_url.example <destination_key>
```
